name: Training the Beast
summary: In Dun Morogh, Grif Wildheart sends young dwarven hunters to Ironforge to learn care for a lasting animal companion. After taming the mountain’s wild predators, they learn to feed and train their beasts.

sections.title: From the Wild to the Forge
sections.body: Young hunters finish their trial near Kharanos under Grif Wildheart’s watch. They have tamed large crag boars, snow leopards, and sturdy ice claw bears with a taming rod. Then Grif sends them up the mountain pass to Ironforge. They seek the Hall of Arms in the military district.

sections.title: Belia Thundergranite's Teachings
sections.body: Belia Thundergranite teaches animal care in Ironforge’s Hall of Arms. Revered among the dwarven kingdom’s master animal trainers, she shows young hunters how to nourish their pets and teach them new battlefield skills. She also teaches them to call their spirits back if they fall defending their master. Her lessons turn a frightened wild beast into a loyal partner.

sections.title: The Dwarven Hunter's Bond
sections.body: Dwarven tradition asks for respect between hunter and beast, never subjugation. Belia reminds young hunters that an animal companion reflects the care it receives. Fed well, respected, and properly trained, a beast will fight loyally against troggs, frost trolls, and any threat to Khaz Modan.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Training the Beast completes a dwarf hunter’s foundational training. You learn to care for a lasting animal companion, feed and train it, call it to your side, and bring it back if it dies.

Belia Thundergranite is a revered master animal trainer and senior instructor in Ironforge’s Hall of Arms. She teaches dwarf hunters care, discipline, and commands that turn tamed beasts into lifelong allies.

faq.q: Where do I find Belia Thundergranite?
aliases: where is hall of arms ironforge
faq.answer: Belia Thundergranite is in Ironforge’s Hall of Arms, the city’s military wing. Dwarf and gnome warriors, hunters, and paladins gather and train there.

faq.q: What beasts do dwarven hunters tame before receiving this training?
faq.answer: Before this training, young hunters use a taming rod to soothe a large crag boar, a snow leopard, and an ice claw bear in Dun Morogh. Grif Wildheart oversees these trials.

faq.q: Why must dwarven hunters feed their pets?
faq.answer: Dwarven beast lore treats animal companions as partners, not tools. A hungry pet grows sullen and less willing to fight. Keep it well-fed to earn its fierce loyalty and help it fight at its best.
Grif Wildheart is a veteran hunter trainer beside the road east of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He gives this training after you complete your third taming trial.

angles.text: As a hunter, you learn to feed, command, and revive a lasting animal companion.
As a dwarf, you inherit Khaz Modan’s tradition of treating bears, boars, and mountain cats as partners in exploring and defending the mountainous wilderness.
As an Alliance member, you rely on Ironforge’s beastmasters. Their loyal companions contribute heavily to Alliance scouting forces and patrol the frigid mountain passes.
